tasks.title: Secure RNS-BGV candidate and cost model

acceptance.clause: Provide one complete phase tree for proof/verification/native/SDK flows with inclusive/exclusive wall and CPU times, worker count/load, allocations/live buffers, ciphertext/key/proof bytes, peak RSS and enforced address-space observations.
acceptance.proof: crates/iroha_measurement/src/schema.rs and crates/iroha_measurement/src/recorder.rs give one phase-tree record for proof, verification, native and sdk flows with inclusive and exclusive wall and CPU times, workers and load, allocation counters and live buffers, typed byte counters, peak RSS and the observed RLIMIT_AS, below proof, Core and model crates (crates/iroha_measurement/tests/layering.rs); cargo test --locked -p iroha_measurement passed and the eight-row FASTPQ flow of crates/iroha_core_privacy/tests/fastpq_phase_tree_measurement.rs produced complete proof and verification trees. Partial, and kept so by decision 2 of scratchpad/codex/a2.md: no address-space limit has been enforced on a real host (python3 scripts/zk_resource_harness.py run --hardware Mac13,2/apple-m1-ultra/20c/128GiB --profile evidence-probe --config evidence-probe --cache-policy warm --output-root /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-takemiyamakoto-devstuff-iroha/e97c4ffe-38a2-4a0a-ad0a-4610af601e8a/scratchpad/status/logs-m1e1-p3/runs --address-space-limit-bytes 8589934592 -- /bin/cat /dev/null is rejected with address_space_limit_not_applied because Darwin refuses RLIMIT_AS, and python3 scripts/zk_resource_harness.py run --address-space-limit-bytes 34359738368 (on a Linux host, where RLIMIT_AS can be applied) is not run), the native and sdk flow kinds are exercised only by the crate's own tests, and no SDK emitter exists beyond the shared descriptor crates/iroha_measurement/fixtures/record_schema_v1.json.

acceptance.clause: Unattributed proving time is at most 1%; record cache/warm-cold policy, named reference hardware, source/artifact/profile/config identity and raw failures.
acceptance.proof: Attribution::within_limit in crates/iroha_measurement/src/report.rs decides the bound in exact integer arithmetic; cargo test --locked -p iroha_core_privacy --features fastpq-replay-measurement --test fastpq_phase_tree_measurement -- --nocapture passed (4 tests: prove 15 ppm and verify 21 ppm unattributed at public-call granularity, one phase holding 993,437 ppm of the proving root) and python3 scripts/zk_resource_harness.py run --hardware Mac13,2/apple-m1-ultra/20c/128GiB --profile test+fastpq-replay-measurement --config defaults --cache-policy warm --output-root /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-takemiyamakoto-devstuff-iroha/e97c4ffe-38a2-4a0a-ad0a-4610af601e8a/scratchpad/status/logs-m1e1-p3/runs -- target/zk-plan-ivm/debug/deps/fastpq_phase_tree_measurement-2b48c821b08d91ec eight_row_transfer_prove_and_verify_have_complete_phase_trees --exact --nocapture was accepted with 16 and 21 ppm, its report naming the cache policy, the operator-asserted hardware, profile and config beside observed host facts, the source commit with its dirty digest and the artifact digest. The plan author ruled the root-exclusive ratio and this FASTPQ run plus the thin X509 adapter tests of crates/iroha_core_privacy/src/privacy_engines/zk_x509/prover_observation.rs (cargo test --locked -p iroha_core_privacy --features fastpq-replay-measurement --lib -- prover_observation phase_tree_record_is_retained, 21 passed) sufficient for E.1, the complete X509 run being owned by X.3 (scratchpad/codex/E.1-q1.md); failed, rejected and unwound flows are retained as records and runs (test_failed_commands_are_recorded_and_earlier_failures_are_never_erased in python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider scripts/tests/zk_resource_harness_test.py).

acceptance.clause: Separate projections, local scheduling and consensus limits.
acceptance.proof: Every quantitative section of the record carries one Classification (projection, engineering_target, deterministic_consensus_bound, local_scheduling, measured) in crates/iroha_measurement/src/schema.rs; declared workers and RLIMIT_AS limits are local_scheduling, and DeclaredClass in crates/iroha_measurement/src/recorder.rs admits a consensus bound only with protocol-constant or committed-State provenance, as the plan author confirmed in scratchpad/codex/E.1-q1.md. unclassified_numbers in crates/iroha_measurement/src/report.rs and its twin in scripts/zk_resource_harness.py find none in the golden record or the harness report: cargo test --locked -p iroha_measurement (100 unit, 5 layering, 6 public_api, 4 doc tests) and python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider scripts/tests/zk_resource_harness_test.py (40 passed) passed.

acceptance.clause: Salvage only unchanged scoped evidence; generated logs remain untracked and evidence cleanup cannot erase failures.
acceptance.proof: The salvage subcommand of scripts/zk_resource_harness.py rebinds manifest digests, judges every record again and compares verdict, reasons and scope with the report; run directories must sit under an untracked ignored root, crates/iroha_measurement/src/sink.rs creates files exclusively and the harness has no removal or overwrite call, each covered by scripts/tests/zk_resource_harness_test.py in python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider scripts/tests/zk_resource_harness_test.py (40 passed). Partial: the manifest is unsigned, so a run rejected only by a stated requirement whose report.json and manifest.json are rewritten consistently is still reported salvageable unless the digest printed by run is passed as --manifest-sha256, and salvage cannot be told a consumer's requirements (open finding 1 of the confirmation, reproduced on this tree with scratchpad/E1-confirm/probe_salvage_requirements.py).

acceptance.clause: Never record private witnesses, secret keys or hidden programs; include device thermal state where applicable.
acceptance.proof: crates/iroha_measurement/src/recorder.rs accepts only static labels, enums and integers, and the harness keeps only length and SHA-256 of stdout, stderr and the argument vector (test_private_text_printed_or_passed_by_the_command_is_not_retained in python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider scripts/tests/zk_resource_harness_test.py); thermal state is observed on macOS (nominal at begin and finish in the accepted FASTPQ harness run) and decoded from Linux sysfs fixtures. Partial under decision 2 of scratchpad/codex/a2.md: the iOS and Android probes in crates/iroha_measurement/src/platform.rs are compile-checked only and carry TODOs, python3 scripts/zk_resource_harness.py run --require-thermal-state (on a physical iOS or Android device through an SDK emitter) is not run, and a file the command itself writes into its record directory is retained and bound without a finding (open finding 3 of the confirmation, reproduced on this tree).

developer_surface_contract.atomic_semantics: An ordinary operation or explicit batch is one atomic signed transaction. IVM queues effects and returns PendingAction tokens; actual outcomes arrive in the final receipt. No silent splitting.
developer_surface_contract.progress_semantics: A single high-level invocation may orchestrate real distributed stages and return a durable pending handle. Reconcile original outcomes before retry; expose cancellation and partial completion without inventing cross-transaction atomicity.
developer_surface_contract.documentation: Each functional delivery includes typed native ISI+Kotodama, mandatory one-call+advanced prepared form, all six SDK families and canonical fixtures, genuine proof and four-validator effect/cold-restart/current-genesis replay. Per-slice SDK work is owned by that delivery; S.3-S.6 reconcile common ports and aggregate evidence rather than gate it.
